spans.s:
Yevāṣa is the name of a destructive insect in the Atharvaveda. The form yavāṣa is found in the kāṭhaka Saṃhitā. Cf. vṛṣa.
Foot notes v. 23, 7. 8.
xxx. 1 (Indische Studien, 3, 462). The same form occurs in the Gaṇas, kumudādi and prekṣādi (Pāṇini, iv. 2, 80). Cf. Maitrāyaṇī Saṃhitā, iv. 8, 1, where yavāṣa should be read; Kapiṣṭhala Saṃhitā, xlvi. 4.
Cf. Zimmer, Altindisches Leben, 98; St. Petersburg Dictionary, s.v.
